scope: 2026-08-08 onward agent-first word ink ownership iteration
policy: Append immutable entries. If a result is superseded, add a successor and preserve the prior entry. primary_record.file_sha256 binds the exact on-disk record; identity_sha256 binds the experiment's own canonical identity when available.

entries.title: Cross-worktree research map
entries.summary: Agent navigation across refs, worktrees, storage roots, technique ordering, evidence boundaries, and negative results.

entries.title: Automatic-selection failure atlas
entries.summary: Twelve false easy approvals; nine selected separable foreign components.

entries.title: Recovery-conditioning sweep v1 invalid wiring
entries.summary: Preserved interpretation-wiring failure; never use for a decision.

entries.title: Ownership-independent recovery-conditioning sweep v2
entries.summary: Larger conditioning added much more foreign than target evidence; demand-trigger only.

entries.title: Disjoint component ownership v1
entries.summary: Transcript global-exclusive assignment yielded 56/77 high-quality and zero duplicate claims; suggestion only.

entries.title: Component score-weight sweep v1
entries.summary: Fragile one-word gain; line-held-out selection fell to 51/77.

entries.title: Cross-line component abstention v1
entries.summary: Blanket cross-line penalty corrected one foreign component but caused more misses.

entries.title: Global acting-only ink line field v1
entries.summary: Acting-only line geometry was coherent, but global blending broke same-line word now.

entries.title: Conservative cross-dispute ink line field v2
entries.summary: Fixed conservative guard changed only answer., improving 56 to 57 high-quality; held-out validation required.

entries.title: Accuracy-v2 explicit V4 full run revision 0
entries.summary: Correct explicit Clean/High Recall bindings, initialized and unchanged at revision 0.

entries.title: Accuracy-v2 isolated ten-word sample revision 0
entries.summary: Ten canonical difficult/easy words; no model action applied because isolated routes are unavailable.

entries.title: Sample10 acting-packet boundary validation
entries.summary: All 12 packet files passed containment, marker, existence, and evidence-hash checks.

entries.title: Line-coordinate ownership v1 incomplete memory run
entries.summary: Retained 1,232 page masks and was stopped before freeze; no sealed evaluation opened.

entries.title: Line-coordinate ownership v2 outer-line spacing failure
entries.summary: Bounded memory succeeded, but outer fitted lines absorbed page number/signature components.

entries.title: Line-coordinate ownership v3 spacing-fixed sweep
entries.summary: Transcript line plus rough span improved 56 to 58 high-quality while reducing foreign and missed pixels.

entries.title: First cross-locator line-choice oracle
entries.summary: Invalid 68/77 oracle mixed locator families independently bound to different target words.

entries.title: Canonical-binding line-coordinate reevaluation
entries.summary: Recorded 72 mismatch receipts and produced a consistent 64/77 proxy; later physical audit proved the binding is not semantic truth.

entries.title: Canonical line-choice plus one-component-toggle audit
entries.summary: Interaction-capacity proxy only: choice reached 64/77 and one edit 70/77 under an unadjudicated one-to-one target binding.

entries.title: Exclusive same-line component-transfer audit
entries.summary: Geometry-proxy transfer audit; direction/gain counts are not semantic evidence until many-to-many target adjudication.

entries.title: Acting-only line-choice and component-toggle packets v1
entries.summary: Eight software-disagreement packets are frozen; isolated model execution is infrastructure-blocked.

entries.title: Line-choice packet boundary validation summary
entries.summary: All eight packet directories passed structural boundary checks with zero violations.

entries.title: Contiguous mask-number reading-order binding
entries.summary: Strongly identified masks 23-99 as the body window but failed left-to-right monotonicity on three lines.

entries.title: Capacity-constrained fitted-line binding
entries.summary: Selected the same body window but exact line capacities forced detached/combined masks into wrong semantic tokens.

entries.title: Sealed many-to-many semantic binding adjudication
entries.summary: Fourteen sealed evaluator boards and a zero-or-more-mask token ledger are ready; adjudication is incomplete.

entries.title: Semantic binding completion-gate negative control
entries.summary: The strict gate correctly rejects the untouched ledger with 92 explicit incompleteness violations.

entries.title: Completed sealed many-to-many semantic binding ledger
entries.summary: First sealed evaluator ledger: 71 scorable units, 6 merged-mask exclusions, 77/77 body masks resolved, zero validation violations.

entries.title: Many-to-many line-candidate reevaluation
entries.summary: Trustworthy scorable-unit results: transcript global 55/71, line strip 57/71, proposal choice 65/71, one toggle 68/71; two toggles add zero.

entries.title: Acting-safe fitted-line component pool expansion
entries.summary: Human-free fitted-line component pools frozen at six along-line margins before sealed evaluation.

entries.title: Sealed fitted-line pool availability and distraction sweep
entries.summary: Promotes staged pools: 0-15% compact default and 45% recovery ceiling; larger pools add distraction without availability gain.

entries.title: Target-directed semantic exclusive component transfer audit
entries.summary: Beneficial target-directed transfers occur both earlier and later; provisional exclusive ownership is supported, fixed direction is not.

entries.title: Completed-page semantic binding audit
entries.summary: Quarantines all one-to-one page-007 HQ counts and defines the required sealed many-to-many target contract.

entries.title: Line-coordinate ownership durable checkpoint
entries.summary: Exact failures, proxy metrics, packet hashes, tests, blocker, and a superseding warning that semantic target binding is pending.

entries.title: Semantic binding and fitted-line pool durable checkpoint
entries.summary: Exact semantic ledger, trustworthy proposal metrics, staged pool tradeoff, corrected order audit, guardrails, and next experiments.

entries.title: SBB Binarization 2021 acting-safe faint-page trial
entries.summary: SBB produced coherent, low-noise handwriting evidence on one acting-safe faint page but omitted faint word portions; proposal evidence only.

entries.title: SBB 2021 foreground-probability preservation and threshold sweep
entries.summary: Preserved two-channel probability exactly reproduces hard output at 0.50; 0.20 adds 25,170 mostly stroke-adjacent pixels but does not recover whole near-zero-probability words.

entries.title: Eynollah/SBB hybrid CNN-Transformer three-page acting-safe cohort
entries.summary: The hybrid retained 96.93% of old p0.50 ink and added 159,697 coherent pixels on faint page 003, generalized strongly to folded page 002, and exposed high-confidence glass-ring/page-edge false foreground on 001. Promote probability for geometry-conditioned testing, not as handwriting or ownership truth.

entries.title: Eynollah hybrid whole-component admission by Kraken line geometry
entries.summary: Pixel clipping removed non-text but broke strokes. A 30px line corridor with whole-component overlap >=25% retained 82.21% of hybrid ink while visually excluding both glass rings and the page edge; hold for independent-page testing with residual safeguards.

entries.title: Frozen hybrid whole-component line admission on independent folded page 002
entries.summary: The unchanged 30px/25% policy retained 99.9166% of hybrid ink and rejected only 264 top-boundary pixels outside the photographed paper; recall-safe on an already-clean independent page.

entries.title: Hybrid-seeded full-page source recovery
entries.summary: Page-wide source adaptation recovered near-zero-probability writing but also ruling, folds, borders, texture, and thousands of fragments. Reject every page-wide profile; retain as negative evidence for geometry-local recovery.

entries.title: Hybrid-seeded local word/line-crop source recovery
entries.summary: Conservative local recovery reconnects some faint source-visible strokes that hybrid scored below 0.01. Use tight+conservative first, expand along line on defer, offer balanced second; maximum recall and wholesale selection are rejected.

entries.title: Eynollah hybrid crop/context/multiscale inference
entries.summary: Tight black-padded and enlarged crop inference substantially lost full-page hybrid ink on three frozen probes. Native real context produced occasional useful disagreement but failed the almost-erased word; keep the full-page probability as anchor.

entries.title: Native-scale Eynollah crop preprocessing
entries.summary: CLAHE 1.5 exposed plausible moderate-faint continuations but also thickened ink and selected non-writing; paper flattening improved human visibility without reliable model recovery. Offer CLAHE only as a distinct component-gated proposal layer.

entries.title: CLAHE-Eynollah proposals gated by local source-recovery evidence
entries.summary: Whole-component agreement with independent local source recovery reduces CLAHE proposal fragmentation and concentrates moderate-faint candidates. It remains optional evidence and does not reconstruct the almost-erased word.

entries.title: Page-adaptive source-feature vector ink
entries.summary: Page-local source-feature prototypes are the first tested method to expose most disconnected near-erased writing, but the ungated mask floods paper texture and is diagnostic only. Pseudo-label AUC was actively misleading; clean seed-bound graph methods did not recover the disconnected word.

entries.title: Positive-unknown rough-line-conditioned vector ink
entries.summary: Treating low-confidence pixels inside the rough line as unknown instead of negative reduced the near-erased-word proposal from 24,625 to 7,502 pixels and from 2,946 to 239 components while retaining most visible word structure. Promote only as optional high-recall proposal evidence.

entries.title: Unconditional fitted-line gate over vector proposals
entries.summary: Reject unconditional fitted-line clipping. A sparse five-bin anchor produced an invented -0.1597 slope and deleted most of the newly recovered word, demonstrating that geometry must abstain when its evidence is weak.

entries.title: Fitted-line quality and abstention gate
entries.summary: A frozen evidence-quality gate correctly abstained on the destructive sparse fit and preserved all 7,502 upstream proposal pixels. It accepted one strong fit and conservatively rejected another near threshold; target-line retention needs refinement before precision use.

entries.title: Line-conditioned vector proposal same-page held-out check
entries.summary: The unchanged proposal policy recovered coherent faint middle-phrase structure on a distinct same-page line, adding 5,966 pixels and 431 components. This supports the mechanism but is not cross-page or cross-collection generalization evidence.

entries.title: Three-tier vector component review surface
entries.summary: Partition vector components into strong, likely, and exploratory tiers by independent local-recovery support. The tiers are a review order, not labels: the near-erased word remains mainly exploratory precisely because every earlier method missed it, so exploratory evidence must never be silently discarded.

entries.title: Automatic Kraken-line vector proposals across pages
entries.summary: Kraken boundaries automatically centered six software-selected lines on two independent pages, and unchanged vector proposals stayed concentrated on stroke gaps without catastrophic paper flooding. Fragment burden remains 259-652 additions per line with median area one pixel, so geometry is promoted only as a search corridor.

entries.title: Exact-pixel vector fragment grouping
entries.summary: Balanced anisotropic grouping reduced 36-168 raw evidence components to 10-22 editable left-to-right colour groups while preserving every exact ink pixel. Visual word alignment is promising, but tight splits marks and broad merges neighbors; expose all as correction challengers rather than ownership truth.

entries.title: Natural near-erased-word enhancement
entries.summary: A page-specific LAB ink-direction transform doubled faint-proxy contrast with no clipping; ridge gating delivered a quieter 1.55x gain. Generic sharpening and blunt darkening strengthened paper too, so only ink-vector variants advance to model reinference.

entries.title: Enhanced Eynollah real-context reinference
entries.summary: Page-ink-vector context raised Eynollah p0.50 faint-proxy selection from 0.97% to 34.77% while retaining 90.65% of the full-page anchor and activating zero conservative paper-proxy pixels. Promote as an optional secondary proposal; fragmentation and neighboring-line recovery still require geometry and human ownership review.

entries.title: Faint-ink fragment repair inputs
entries.summary: A raw-vector bridge precursor visibly webbed paper and was rejected before inference. The bounded replacement uses p0.50 Eynollah seeds propagated only through p0.20 source-supported pixels in a centered line corridor; bridge pixels are hash-bound scaffolding that must be removed before geometry or training export.

entries.title: Fragment-repaired Eynollah reinference
entries.summary: Source-only 3x7 reconnect improved p0.50 faint-proxy recall from 34.77% to 52.17%, full-page retention from 90.65% to 96.00%, kept the paper proxy at zero, and reduced exact-source components from 54 to 38. Temporary bridge variants recovered less exact source ink after scaffold removal and are rejected.
